notes:
A handful of small changes that add up, rather than one big wall:
- Tougher zombies: +55 health a round up to round 9 (was +50), then +11% a round (was +10%). Round 10: 655
  (was 605), round 20: 1,860 (was 1,569), round 30: about 5,300 (was 4,070). Sir Chonk scales with it.
- More of them: about 8% more zombies a round by round 10, about 10% more by round 20, and up to 26 at once
  (was 24). They also arrive a little faster.
- Runners come sooner: the first ones can show up in round 2, and 85% of zombies run from about round 6
  (was round 8). Late-game runners are a touch quicker.
- They hit harder: 38 damage a hit (was 35). Three hits still down you at 100 health, with less margin.
- Slower healing: health starts coming back after 4 seconds (was 3.5) at 40 a second (was 45). Quick Fix's
  faster healing is unchanged, so it's worth a little more now.
